questions_and_answers.answer: $21,849.92 is the **interest **will you have paid in total . Hence, option **A **is correct. What is compounded monthly ? • *Compound monthly **refers to a loan's interest rate, which is charged in installments each month and added to the principle . For instance, if a $1,000 loan has a 12% annual **interest **rate compounded monthly, it will accrue 1% interest in the first month and become $1,010. The **principal **amount times one plus the interest rate divided by a number of periods, raised to the **power **of the number of periods , is how monthly **compounding **is computed. The interest amount is calculated by deducting that sum from the principal amount. When the **interest **you earn on your **savings **starts to earn interest on itself, it is what is known as compound interest. As interest increases, it starts to accrue more quickly and builds . Thus, option **A **is correct. For more information about **compounded monthly, **click here: https://brainly.com/question/26078368 #…
